cases.sentence: Покрой ___ его верхушку, стороны и рога и сделай золотой ободок вокруг него.
cases.explain: «чистым золотом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: You shall overlay it with pure gold, its top, its sides around it, and its horns; and you shall make a gold molding around it.

cases.sentence: Покрой чистым золотом его верхушку, стороны и рога и сделай ___ вокруг него.
cases.explain: «золотой ободок» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: You shall overlay it with pure gold, its top, its sides around it, and its horns; and you shall make a gold molding around it.

cases.sentence: Под ободком с двух ___ сделай на жертвеннике два золотых кольца, чтобы держать шесты, на которых его носят.
cases.explain: «противоположных сторон» — after the preposition «с», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: You shall make two golden rings for it under its molding; on its two ribs, on its two sides you shall make them; and they shall be for places for poles with which to bear it.

cases.sentence: Пусть в ___ благовония возжигаются перед Господом постоянно.
cases.explain: «грядущих поколениях» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: When Aaron lights the lamps at evening, he shall burn it, a perpetual incense before Yahweh throughout your generations.

cases.sentence: Не приноси на этом жертвеннике другого благовония, всесожжения или ___ и не делай на нем возлияний.
cases.explain: «хлебного приношения» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: You shall offer no strange incense on it, nor burnt offering, nor meal offering; and you shall pour no drink offering on it.

cases.sentence: Пусть это очищение совершается ежегодно и в ___.
cases.explain: «грядущих поколениях» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Aaron shall make atonement on its horns once in the year; with the blood of the sin offering of atonement once in the year he shall make atonement for it throughout your generations. It is most holy to Yahweh.”

cases.explain: «великая святыня» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Aaron shall make atonement on its horns once in the year; with the blood of the sin offering of atonement once in the year he shall make atonement for it throughout your generations. It is most holy to Yahweh.”

cases.sentence: — Сделай для омовений ___ с бронзовым основанием.
cases.explain: «бронзовый умывальник» — after the preposition «для», the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “You shall also make a basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, in which to wash. You shall put it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and you shall put water in it.

cases.sentence: — Сделай для омовений бронзовый умывальник с ___.
cases.explain: «бронзовым основанием» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “You shall also make a basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, in which to wash. You shall put it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and you shall put water in it.

cases.sentence: Это установление для Аарона и его потомков в ___ будет вечным.
cases.explain: «грядущих поколениях» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: When they go into the Tent of Meeting, they shall wash with water, that they not die; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

cases.sentence: Сделай из них ___ для помазания — искусно приготовленный благовонный состав.
cases.explain: «священное масло» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: You shall make it into a holy anointing oil, a perfume compounded after the art of the perfumer: it shall be a holy anointing oil.

cases.explain: «священное масло» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: You shall make it into a holy anointing oil, a perfume compounded after the art of the perfumer: it shall be a holy anointing oil.

cases.sentence: Освяти их; они будут ___, и все, что прикоснется к ним, станет свято.
cases.explain: «великой святыней» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: You shall sanctify them, that they may be most holy. Whatever touches them shall be holy.

cases.sentence: Скажи израильтянам: «Это Мое ___ для помазания в грядущих поколениях.
cases.explain: «священное масло» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘This shall be a holy anointing oil to me throughout your generations.

cases.sentence: Скажи израильтянам: «Это Мое священное масло для помазания в ___.
cases.explain: «грядущих поколениях» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘This shall be a holy anointing oil to me throughout your generations.

cases.explain: «великой святыней» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: You shall beat some of it very small, and put some of it before the covenant in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be to you most holy.

cases.sentence: Не делайте себе благовоний по этому рецепту; помните, что это — ___.
cases.explain: «Господня святыня» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The incense which you shall make, according to its composition you shall not make for yourselves: it shall be to you holy for Yahweh.

cases.sentence: Всякий, кто сделает ___, чтобы наслаждаться его запахом, будет исторгнут из своего народа.
cases.explain: «подобный состав» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Whoever shall make any like that, to smell of it, he shall be cut off from his people.”
